en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from Abu Hamza, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A town would not be hit by a Punishment while there are seven from the Momineen therein’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ib Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu Hamza from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
A town in which seven believers live remains safe from torment.”
